name: Ravi
self_text: Coming from an engineering background, I enjoy the precision of my urban garden. Recently, I have been studying language practice. I find that I work best with a step-by-step walkthrough session. I am available to meet in person on Sunday mornings or during weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into language practice and step-by-step walkthrough sessions. You have to be available either Sunday morning or weekday evenings. I'd strongly prefer that we overlap on in person, though it's not a requirement.
